The '''Western Ice Shelf''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
The [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' landed in the area during the [[Galactic War]] after an exploration travel that lasted thousands of years. The Western Ice Shelf then saw heavy fighting between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as they tried to uncover the secrets of the Gree starship.<ref name="TOR:RotG">{{TORcite|Event: "Relics of the Gree"}}</ref>
